basic_profile.bio: I'm a cybersecurity enthusiast from Toronto, currently preparing for my CISSP exam. I work as an IT support technician and aspire to become a security consultant. I enjoy reading about technology and love setting up virtual labs to tinker with different software. In my free time, I browse Reddit to learn and occasionally venture into Toronto's food scene. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT support, with a focus on network security. I've been self-teaching through online courses and hands-on practice in virtual labs. My goal is to specialize in cybersecurity, and I'm currently studying for the CISSP certification.
